say:8:1010309005:0.source_cn: 既然已经收了钱，我就不会把那些事说出去。

say:8:1010309005:0.female: I've already been paid, so don't expect me to say anything.

say:10:1010309006:0.text: Hmph... I probably shouldn't have said that.

say:11:1010309007:0.text: I'll split a portion of my take if you promise not to tell Lord Franz.
say:11:1010309007:0.source_cn: 我把钱分你一点，你别告诉弗朗茨老爷。
say:11:1010309007:0.male: I'll split a portion of my take if you promise not to tell Lord Franz.
say:11:1010309007:0.female: I'll split a portion of my take if you promise not to tell Lord Franz.

say:12:1010309037:0.text: Instead of pestering me here, why don't you go look around where the fire happened?
say:12:1010309037:0.source_cn: 与其在这里问我，还不如自己去着火的地方看看。

say:13:1010309038:0.text: If you find something, Lord Franz might even reward you.
say:13:1010309038:0.source_cn: 如果能查出点什么，老爷说不定也会送你们一笔钱呢。

say:16:1010309008:0.text: Don't say it like that? I'm just choosing to keep Lord Franz's secrets.
say:16:1010309008:0.source_cn: 别说得那么难听，我是自愿替老爷保守秘密的。
say:16:1010309008:0.male: Don't say it like that? I'm just choosing to keep Lord Franz's secrets.
say:16:1010309008:0.female: Don't say it like that? I'm just choosing to keep Lord Franz's secrets.

say:17:1010309009:0.text: I don't care what his plan is for the wheat fields. I want to know when this lake will thaw!

say:17:1010309009:0.female: I don't care what his plan is for the wheat fields. I want to know when this lake will thaw!

say:18:1010309010:0.source_cn: 我只是一个穷渔夫，谁会闲着没事来威胁我？

say:20:1010309011:0.source_cn: 当然不是，老爷可是大善人，还会接济我这样的穷人呢。

say:21:1010309012:0.female: Nonsense, they just want to learn my secret fishing techniques.

say:3:1010310001:1.text: What happened? Who's that? You were talking to him for a long time.
say:3:1010310001:1.source_cn: 怎么回事？我看你们和那人聊了很久，他是什么人？

say:4:1010310002:1.text: A fisherman. He knows something, but he doesn't want to talk.
say:4:1010310002:1.source_cn: 一个渔夫，他好像知道点什么，但不管怎么问都不肯说。

say:5:1010310003:1.text: Oh no, at this rate, the evidence may be covered in snow before we find anything.
say:5:1010310003:1.source_cn: 再这么下去，在我们调查出火灾的真相前，一切都将被淹没在...

say:6:1010310004:1.text: Weren't you investigating the strange weather in Ryeham, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Any progress?
say:6:1010310004:1.male: Weren't you investigating the strange weather in Ryeham, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Any progress?

choice_prompt:7:1010310004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你之前不是在调查金穗村的异变吗？你有什么发现？
choice_prompt:7:1010310004.male: Weren't you investigating the strange weather in Ryeham, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Any progress?
choice_prompt:7:1010310004.female: Weren't you investigating the strange weather in Ryeham, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Any progress?

say:8:1010310005:1.text: Do you think he knew you were investigating and is purposefully interfering?
say:8:1010310005:1.source_cn: 会不会是有人得知你在调查异变，刻意干扰你？
say:8:1010310005:1.male: Do you think he knew you were investigating and is purposefully interfering?
say:8:1010310005:1.female: Do you think he knew you were investigating and is purposefully interfering?

say:9:1010310006:1.text: If so... someone else may have discovered your true identity.
say:9:1010310006:1.source_cn: 或许……猜出你身份的人，不止我一个。
say:9:1010310006:1.male: If so... someone else may have discovered your true identity.
say:9:1010310006:1.female: If so... someone else may have discovered your true identity.

say:10:1010310007:1.text: Along with the fire, it's possible that the falling snow was also part of their plan.
say:10:1010310007:1.source_cn: 不止那场火灾，就连这场能够掩埋真相的雪，可能也在他们的...
say:10:1010310007:1.male: Along with the fire, it's possible that the falling snow was also part of their plan.
say:10:1010310007:1.female: Along with the fire, it's possible that the falling snow was also part of their plan.

say:12:1010310009:1.text: Hey! Keep those bunny ears out of our conversation!
say:12:1010310009:1.source_cn: 捂紧你的兔子耳朵，不该听的不要听。

say:16:1010310011:1.text: Oh...! I was about to tell you all something, but after Lorsan's interruption, I've completely forgotten what it was! I'm terribly sorry!
say:16:1010310011:1.source_cn: 啊！糟糕……我刚刚就想告诉诸位一件事来着，被洛桑大人打...

say:17:1010310012:1.text:
You see, before you all arrived, I conducted an experiment here.
And the results were completely beyond my expectations!
say:17:1010310012:1.source_cn: 其实，在你们来之前，我做了一场实验。\n实验结果出乎我...

say:19:1010310014:1.text: That Merlin's ward... is gradually weakening.
say:19:1010310014:1.male: That Merlin's ward... is gradually weakening.
say:19:1010310014:1.female: That Merlin's ward... is gradually weakening.

say:26:1010310017:1.text: Not only that, I discovered that another mage attempted to <style="highlight">restore the ward</style> but could not stop it from weakening.
say:26:1010310017:1.source_cn: 除此之外，我还探查到有魔法师在试图<style=str...

say:27:1010310018:1.text: No, no, no... How could this be?!

say:28:1010310019:1.text: Sir Chippy... As a member of the Lyceum, I would never report something unless I was sure.
say:28:1010310019:1.source_cn: 满满大人，我是严谨的学者，不会轻易下定论。

choice_prompt:29:1010310019.text: Sir Chippy... As a member of the Lyceum, I would never report something unless I was sure.
choice_prompt:29:1010310019.source_cn: 满满大人，我是严谨的学者，不会轻易下定论。

say:30:1010310020:1.text: But how is that possible? No one's ever been able to dispel Merlin's magic!
say:30:1010310020:1.source_cn: 怎么可能呢，科丝蒂小姐！没人能动摇梅林的魔法！
say:30:1010310020:1.male: But how is that possible? No one's ever been able to dispel Merlin's magic!
say:30:1010310020:1.female: But how is that possible? No one's ever been able to dispel Merlin's magic!

say:31:1010310021:1.text: As an ardent student of magic and all of Merlin's works, I am also in total disbelief... However, I can assure you that I am telling the truth.
say:31:1010310021:1.source_cn: 作为梅林的崇拜者，我和你一样不愿相信，但……事实如此。
say:31:1010310021:1.male: As an ardent student of magic and all of Merlin's works, I am also in total disbelief... However, I can assure you that I am telling the truth.
say:31:1010310021:1.female: As an ardent student of magic and all of Merlin's works, I am also in total disbelief... However, I can assure you that I am telling the truth.

say:32:1010310024:1.source_cn: 炽热……炽热的魔力……会是谁呢？

say:38:1010310026:1.text: I'm no mind-reader. Some things can be reasoned out.
say:38:1010310026:1.source_cn: 我不会读心术，但我会推理。
say:38:1010310026:1.male: I'm no mind-reader. Some things can be reasoned out.
say:38:1010310026:1.female: I'm no mind-reader. Some things can be reasoned out.

say:39:1010310027:1.text: Also, after spending this much time together, I can guess what you're thinking.
say:39:1010310027:1.source_cn: 另外，我和你相处了一段时间，你的想法，我能猜到一二。

say:42:1010310028:1.text: Tell us, Valen! Who do you think tried to restore Merlin's ward?
say:42:1010310028:1.source_cn: 维伦先生！修复加护的人究竟是谁啊？

say:44:1010310030:1.text: After being accused of starting the fire, she refused to explain why she was there. There must be something stopping her from telling us.
say:44:1010310030:1.source_cn: 她被认定为纵火犯时，无论如何都不愿说清自己来到此地的原...

say:45:1010310031:1.text: If she was trying to repair the ward, she probably didn't want everyone to know that it was weakening.
say:45:1010310031:1.source_cn: 既然她在修复加护，大概是不愿让其他人知道，加护正在衰弱...

say:48:1010310032:1.text: Umm... I have no idea what any of you are talking about.
say:48:1010310032:1.source_cn: 嗯……我完全听不懂你们在说什么呢。

say:50:1010310034:1.text: Strange weather... the fire... the grapes... and now someone is trying to fix Merlin's ward...
say:50:1010310034:1.source_cn: 异变……火灾……葡萄……修复加护的人……

say:51:1010310035:1.text: Oh no... Chippy's brain hurts! Chippy can't figure this out!
say:51:1010310035:1.source_cn: 不行不行……满满的脑袋好痛！\n主人！满满想不明白！
say:51:1010310035:1.male: Oh no... Chippy's brain hurts! Chippy can't figure this out!
say:51:1010310035:1.female: Oh no... Chippy's brain hurts! Chippy can't figure this out!

choice_prompt:52:1010310035.male: Oh no... Chippy's brain hurts! Chippy can't figure this out!
choice_prompt:52:1010310035.female: Oh no... Chippy's brain hurts! Chippy can't figure this out!

say:55:1010310039:1.text: Right now, we're still missing that last piece of evidence.
say:55:1010310039:1.source_cn: 现在，我们只缺少一样关键性证据。

say:56:1010310040:1.text: I have a feeling that everything will fall into place once we find the real culprit behind the fire.
say:56:1010310040:1.source_cn: 我有种预感，只要确定了纵火的真凶，一切都会迎刃而解。

say:59:1010310041:1.text: Then what are we still waiting for? Let's hurry over to the scene of the fire and investigate!
say:59:1010310041:1.source_cn: 那我们还等什么？赶紧去找火灾现场进行调查吧。

say:64:1010310036:1.text: Haven't you guys ever untangled a ball of yarn? The most important step is finding the end of the thread first.
say:64:1010310036:1.source_cn: 你们没有解过毛线团吗？最重要的是，把线头先找出来。

say:65:1010310037:1.text: Things may seem like they're getting more complicated, but doesn't this just prove that we've gathered lots of clues?
say:65:1010310037:1.source_cn: 事态看似越来越麻烦，这不也证明，我们的线索越来越多了吗？

say:66:1010310038:1.text: I have a feeling that everything will fall into place once we find the real culprit behind the fire.
say:66:1010310038:1.source_cn: 我有种预感，只要确定了纵火的真凶，一切都会迎刃而解。

say:67:1010310022:1.text: The magic felt brazen and hot but determined... I have no idea who it belonged to.
say:67:1010310022:1.source_cn: 我不确定，那是一种炽热、坚定的魔力，我不知道它属于谁。

say:68:1010310023:1.text: Whoever was trying to repair the ward was too forceful. It clashed with Merlin's magic. As a result, it showed very little effect.
say:68:1010310023:1.source_cn: 很遗憾……干涉手段过于直接粗暴，无法与梅林的力量相容，...
say:68:1010310023:1.male: Whoever was trying to repair the ward was too forceful. It clashed with Merlin's magic. As a result, it showed very little effect.
say:68:1010310023:1.female: Whoever was trying to repair the ward was too forceful. It clashed with Merlin's magic. As a result, it showed very little effect.

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 突发火灾，没来得及调查

say:1:1010312001:1.text: Lord Franz is in cahoots with bandits and standing in our way to the truth!
say:1:1010312001:1.source_cn: 弗朗茨果然在和盗匪勾结……阻挠我们接近真相！

say:2:1010312002:1.text: It looks like our hard work is starting to pay off.
say:2:1010312002:1.source_cn: 忙活了一大圈，总算是有些收获。

say:3:1010312003:1.text: We're all thinking the same thing, right? This fire had nothing to do with magic or with any mage.
say:3:1010312003:1.source_cn: 大家想的都一样吧？结论已经很明确了，这场火灾与魔法师无关。

say:4:1010312004:1.text: Although fire elementals did appear, it was after the fire started. The fire may have attracted them. Someone else sparked the fire before they showed up.
say:4:1010312004:1.source_cn: 事发时，村子里虽然出现了火元素，但火元素并非引发火灾的...

say:5:1010312005:1.text: The real culprits were those people we saw in Southville before—Lord Franz's henchmen.
say:5:1010312005:1.source_cn: 而真正的凶手，是我们在南村见过的那群人——弗朗茨的手下。

say:6:1010312006:1.text: Disguised as locals, they infiltrated the village, and set fire to the wheat.
say:6:1010312006:1.source_cn: 他们伪装成村民，混入这里，一把火烧着了小麦堆。

say:7:1010312007:1.text: The villagers already had a poor harvest due to the cold weather... If Lord Franz burned that wheat, then what are the villagers supposed to sell? That's their only source of income!
say:7:1010312007:1.source_cn: 气候寒冷，收成本就不好……弗朗茨命人烧了那些麦子，村民...

say:8:1010312008:1.text: I can't believe he would resort to such underhanded means just to force Northville to plant his grapes.
say:8:1010312008:1.source_cn: 为了让北村的农户种葡萄，那个人竟然用这么肮脏的手段逼村...

choice_prompt:9:1010312008.text: I can't believe he would resort to such underhanded means just to force Northville to plant his grapes.
choice_prompt:9:1010312008.source_cn: 为了让北村的农户种葡萄，那个人竟然用这么肮脏的手段逼村民就范！

say:10:1010312009:1.text: While everything is pointing to Lord Franz right now, I think it's still too early to confront him.
say:10:1010312009:1.source_cn: 虽然现在一切都指向弗朗茨，但我觉得，还不能收网。

say:11:1010312010:1.text: What we need to do is learn more about those weird grapes.
say:11:1010312010:1.source_cn: 我们得弄清楚，那些葡萄究竟是什么鬼东西。

say:13:1010312014:1.text: I've made a preliminary analysis regarding this, if everyone will listen.
say:13:1010312014:1.source_cn: 关于这件事，我有个初步分析，请大家听一听。

say:14:1010312015:1.text:
The magic that surrounds Northville is as clear and pure as spring water.
While the magic in Southville, on the other hand, is as thick and muddy as a swamp.
say:14:1010312015:1.source_cn: 北村的魔力如清泉般洁净，\n反观南村的魔力，则如沼泽般...

say:15:1010312016:1.text: The biggest difference between the two is their crops.
say:15:1010312016:1.source_cn: 两地最大的不同，在于作物。

say:16:1010312017:1.text: I suspect that those grapes are responsible for polluting the magic in that area.
say:16:1010312017:1.source_cn: 我怀疑……是那些葡萄污染了当地的魔力。

say:17:1010312018:1.text: To test my hypothesis, I'd like to return to Southville to gather some samples.
say:17:1010312018:1.source_cn: 为了验证我的猜测，我打算回南村取样调查。

say:19:1010312019:1.text: How are you going to do that when Lord Franz is guarding those grapes so closely?
say:19:1010312019:1.source_cn: 你要怎么取样呢，那些葡萄，弗朗茨不是管得很严吗？

say:21:1010312021:1.text: Miss Cassadee, don't tell me you plan on... stealing some?

say:22:1010312022:1.text: It's not stealing if it's for research purposes! Besides, I'm only doing this to get closer to the truth.
say:22:1010312022:1.source_cn: 研究者的工作，怎么能叫偷呢？这是为了接近真相。

say:23:1010312023:1.text: I only need a single, tiny grape! No one will ever know it's missing!
say:23:1010312023:1.source_cn: 我只需要一颗小小的葡萄就好，不会被任何人发现的！

say:24:1010312024:1.text: Then I'll take my leave. May Dura protect you!
say:24:1010312024:1.source_cn: 那我先走一步，愿艾雅祝福你们！
say:24:1010312024:1.male: Then I'll take my leave. May Dura protect you!
say:24:1010312024:1.female: Then I'll take my leave. May Dura protect you!

say:27:1010312025:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, everyone... But I must be going.
say:27:1010312025:1.source_cn: 各位……很抱歉打断你们，我得先走一步了。

say:28:1010312026:1.text: Mirael is still being held captive by General Hogan. I need to return to Holistone and clear her of any wrongdoing.
say:28:1010312026:1.source_cn: 我必须马上回圣石镇，米瑞尔还被霍根将军关押着，我得立刻...

say:29:1010312027:1.text: But more importantly, I need to apologize to her in person. Lord Franz was the real culprit all along, and I am partly to blame for all of the suffering she has endured...
say:29:1010312027:1.source_cn: 更重要的是，我要亲自向她道歉，她遭受的这一切，都怪我冤...

say:31:1010312028:1.text: General Hogan will want to know more about what's been happening here. I need to make a trip back to Holistone, as well.
say:31:1010312028:1.source_cn: 霍根将军可能想了解更详细的情况，我也得回一趟圣石镇。

say:32:1010312029:1.text: Lord Franz will never admit to starting the fire. He holds a lot of power around here. Getting him to confess is something that needs to be discussed with the general.
say:32:1010312029:1.source_cn: 弗朗茨不可能承认自己派人放火。\n他毕竟是当地有权有势...

say:34:1010312031:1.text: I'll treat you to whatever you want back in Holistone. And don't worry, it'll be on the general's dime!
say:34:1010312031:1.source_cn: 回了圣石镇，我请你吃饭——随便点单，反正最后付账的是将军！
say:34:1010312031:1.male: I'll treat you to whatever you want back in Holistone. And don't worry, it'll be on the general's dime!
say:34:1010312031:1.female: I'll treat you to whatever you want back in Holistone. And don't worry, it'll be on the general's dime!

say:36:1010312011:1.text: I'm sure Lord Franz wouldn't just let us question him, either.
say:36:1010312011:1.source_cn: 弗朗茨恐怕不会乖乖任我们质问。

say:37:1010312012:1.text:
"Hey, Lord Franz, what are you plotting?"
"What nonsense are you spewing, insolent wretch! Guards! Seize them!"
say:37:1010312012:1.source_cn: “弗朗茨，你有什么阴谋？”\n“胡说八道什么，卫兵，给...

say:38:1010312013:1.text: Yeah... If we want to avoid that, we'll need to approach things from a different angle.
say:38:1010312013:1.source_cn: 为了避免这种情况发生，我们还是先从别的地方入手吧。

choice:9:1:2.text: We need to find Lord Franz.
choice:9:1:2.male: We need to find Lord Franz.
choice:9:1:2.female: We need to find Lord Franz.

subtitle:2:1011088001:.text: The gruglins are even more erratic than usual...
subtitle:2:1011088001:.source_cn: 行为举止比平时更愚蠢……

subtitle:2:1011088002:.text: Could these grapes be the reason?
subtitle:2:1011088002:.source_cn: 是因为吃了那些葡萄么？

subtitle:2:1011088003:.text: What kind of grapes can send these creatures into such a frenzy...?
subtitle:2:1011088003:.source_cn: 竟能让它们完全陷入狂热状态，这葡萄究竟是……
